summary: the fusion order path sizes and rounds in the instrument's own contract terms: cash-at-risk becomes a quantity by dividing by price x contract multiplier — the money value of one unit — so |qty| x price x multiplier equals the unit notional asked for in every asset class, and rounding is whole-units only for multiplier-1 names (equities/FX unchanged exactly) and at order scale for a contract; a name with no contract spec plans flat rather than being sized as if it were a share (ADR-0078)
